content.short: RedStone is a blockchain oracle network that delivers market data feeds to DeFi apps across many chains.
content.description: RedStone provides price feeds and other data streams for lending markets, derivatives, staking protocols, and tokenized asset platforms. Its documentation describes a modular design that separates data collection from delivery, which helps protocols integrate frequently updated feeds without the overhead of a traditional push based oracle model. On TON, RedStone fits as shared infrastructure that can supply external market data to apps built on the network, especially products that need dependable pricing for trading, lending, and collateral logic.
